profile.headline: Software Consultant and Developer
profile.summary:
• Versatile software consultant & architect with 26+ years of experience designing and developing solutions and enterprise systems for automotive, manufacturing and commercial clients.
• Proven expertise in desktop, web, IoT, embedded Linux, and real-time embedded systems.
• Skilled in Agile/Scrum and TDD, with a strong track record mentoring teams and delivering production-quality software to high-profile clients.

positions.description:
• Versatile software consultant & architect with 26+ years of experience designing and developing solutions and enterprise systems for automotive, manufacturing and commercial clients.

• Proven expertise in desktop, web, embedded Linux, IoT and real-time embedded systems.

• Skilled in Agile/Scrum and TDD, with a strong track record mentoring teams and delivering production-quality software to high-profile clients.

company.name: Bytewise, LLC - Software Consulting and Development

positions.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Developed microservices for controlling an industrial robot in Python and C++ using the ROS2 robot framework.

• Performed DevOps work, including developing Github Actions for CI/CD pipelines, VSCode IDE support, build report generation and developed robot provisioning software in Python.

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed firmware IoT systems with in-vehicle micro-location sensors for passive entry using Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth Channel Sounding, Machine Learning, FreeRTOS, CAN, BLE, LTE and C/C++ with ARM Cortex-M heterogeneous SOCs.

• Collaborated directly with Apple and Google to integrate Phone-as-a-Key solutions, establishing secure chains of trust between smartphones and vehicles using a secure element (SE).

• Built and maintained CI/CD infrastructure for the firmware development pipeline using Jenkins, Python, Ceedling, CppUTest and Renode.
positions.insights: Skills: Ultra Wideband (UWB) · Free RTOS · Renode · CAN bus · Bluetooth Channel Sounding · Embedded Software · Unity/CMock · I2C · SPI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Managed client relationship and provided consultation on project management and execution for a project migrating a legacy C++ application to C# .NET.

• Developed software for custom test equipment with industrial HMI that monitors steel casting operations using accelerometers, OPC, C# .NET and microservices using MassTransit/RabbitMQ.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · Microservices · OPC Unified Architecture (OPC UA) · HMI Programming · Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)

positions.title: Career Development Manager
positions.description:
• Helped makers maintain a healthy work-life balance.

• Worked with makers to help them identify and carry out professional development action plans.

• Worked with other Career Development Managers to identify and eliminate sources of contention.

positions.title: Software Consultant & Developer
positions.description:
• Assumed project manager, tech-lead and developer roles for development of a brake and bearing monitor
system for semi trailers using C, ARM Cortex-M, ADC and 900 MHz wireless connectivity to a L TE cellular
uplink.

• Developed an enterprise web application for creating and publishing troubleshooting and maintenance
documentation for commercial vehicles using TypeScript with React frontend and Node.js and PostgreSQL
backend hosted in Microsoft Azure.

• Developed C++ Qt GUI applications for controlling and monitoring vehicle ECUs in the international company’shigh-end tractor platform. Also mentored team members in Test-Driven Development (TDD) and
Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) methodologies.

• Developed systems for auto-dimming mirrors and automatic high/low beam headlight control using C, CAN
and UDS for automobiles. Introduced the organization to automated unit and integration testing with our
in-house developed Ceedling test framework that is now used internationally for validating safety-critical
embedded systems.

• Consulted with a Tier 1 automotive industry client to develop an framework to automate traceability of code
and tests to requirements in DOORS in order to achieve ISO 26262 certification and MISRA compliance.

• Developed an ultra low-latency A/V streaming platform using H.264, Opus, MPEG and Matroska for wireless
streaming from Windows and Mac laptops to conference room displays.

• Developed motor control and battery charging modules for AGVs using C and PIC microcontrollers with
CAN connectivity, including driver development. Also, created automated test frameworks, Unity and
CMock for a custom CI/CD pipeline with IAR simulators and HIL test integration.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed color measurement instrumentation devices for display and printer calibration using C with 8051 and ARM microcontrollers, C/C++, ADCs, Op Amps and USB connectivity.

• Developed sub-assembly and end-of-line hardware test fixtures for calibration and validation of products using C# and Visual Basic.

positions.title: Test Tools Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed test hardware and software for inducing faults and running automated tests on high-availability enterprise storage devices using C/C++.

• Contributed to 3 patents.
